blocks.orig: Serengeti Sound of Silence is a tented camp where every kind of luxury is present. It offers an amazing view from the tent over the savannas of Serengeti National Park. In addition, this tented camp has an à la carte restaurant where high-quality food is served.
blocks.html: Serengeti Sound of Silence is a tented camp with every kind of luxury on hand. From your tent you have an amazing view over the savannas of Serengeti National Park. The camp also has an à la carte restaurant serving high-quality food.

blocks.orig: The luxurious tents are not only more spacious than those in other tented camps but also have a unique African ambience. They are equipped with a large king-size bed and a comfortable shower. Your Tanzania Trip has been involved in the development of this tented camp since Day One because we noticed that there is a demand for such a luxurious and distinctive tented camp. If you want to get the most out of your Serengeti safari experience we recommend staying at this unique camp. You will have an outstanding and wonderful experience.
blocks.html: The luxurious tents are roomier than those at other tented camps, and they have a unique African atmosphere as well. Inside you find a large king-size bed and a comfortable shower. Your Tanzania Trip has been part of the development of this tented camp from Day One, because we saw there was demand for a luxurious, distinctive tented camp like this. To get the most out of your Serengeti safari, we recommend a stay at this unique camp. Your experience will be outstanding and wonderful.
